name: Open Call Producer
tagline: Turns a photography open call into a checked submission pack built around your shots.
description: Paste in an exhibition open call and it breaks the brief into what selectors actually want - theme, sizing, file specs, deadlines. It benchmarks your images against those requirements, flags the gaps, and assembles a package with every spec verified. You review and send it yourself: nothing is submitted for you.
author: sashanaria
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
